Class 7 Geography

Water and its uses · 25 marks · 60 minutes

Student copy — answer all questions

Section A · 5 × 5 marks

1. Explain the water cycle with its main stages. [5]

2. Describe two ways that communities can conserve water. [5]

3. Explain how rainfall supports rivers and groundwater. [5]

4. Describe how freshwater and ocean water differ. [5]

5. Explain why clean drinking water matters. [5]

data.title: Class 10 Science
data.paperHtml:
Class 10 Science

Light and reflection · 40 marks · 60 minutes

Student copy — answer all questions

Section A · 8 × 5 marks

1. State the laws of reflection and draw a labelled diagram. [5]

2. Explain how an image forms in a plane mirror. [5]

3. Describe reflection from a smooth and a rough surface. [5]

4. Explain two uses of concave mirrors. [5]

5. Describe the image formed by a convex mirror. [5]

6. Explain why a pencil appears bent in water. [5]

7. Compare reflection and refraction with examples. [5]

8. Explain one practical use of a lens. [5]
